turns.reply:
[offline demo: templated from the knowledge base, not a language model] Here is what I can tell you in general terms:
- The Code sets time limits for paying wages (for monthly wages, by the 7th day of the next month). If an employee is removed, dismissed, retrenched or resigns, wages must be paid within 2 working days of that. (Section 17, Code on Wages, 2019)
- Employers may only make deductions from wages that the Code allows, and total deductions are capped (the cap commonly cited is 50% of wages in a pay period). (Section 18, Code on Wages, 2019)
- The employer is responsible for paying the wages and other dues owed to the employee under the Code. (Section 43, Code on Wages, 2019)
To prepare your papers, could you tell me the employer / company name?
